title: Weekly market digest — São Paulo and Zürich desks

items.headline: Port volumes recover after the strike
items.summary: Container throughput returned to its seasonal average within nine days.

items.headline: Café chains raise prices again
items.summary: Three national chains added between four and seven percent to menu prices.

items.headline: Rail freight bookings flatten
items.summary: Bookings held steady for a fourth week as fuel costs stabilised.
